subject: Payout withheld: GCP invoice VAT/entity mismatch — evidence and next steps
messages:
From: Acme Analytics <billing@acme.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Finance <finance@acme.com>, GCP Billing Support <gcp-billing-support@google.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: June payout withheld — invoice shows VAT hold and entity mismatch

Hi Evelyn,

We just noticed our June payout from GCP Marketplace has been held back and the invoice shows a VAT tag flagged to a different legal entity (Acme EMEA LLC) instead of our expected Acme US Inc. The banner on the seller console references a "VAT/Entity mismatch" and payments are pending.

I've attached the June invoice PDF (Acme_GCP_Invoice_June2027.pdf) and a quick note from our finance team. Can Redwood confirm whether the invoice lines were routed to the wrong merchant entity on your marketplace listing? This is blocking our bank payment run — we need a path to clear the hold or a credit to offset the withheld amount.

What we can provide on our side: signed W-9, VAT registration evidence for the EMEA entity (if needed), and bank remittance proof from last cycle. Please let us know what Redwood needs to unblock the payout.

Thanks,
Lara Patel
Billing Operations — Acme Analytics
billing@acme.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

— Attachment: Acme_GCP_Invoice_June2027.pdf (invoice, 2 pages)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: GCP Billing Support <gcp-billing-support@google.com>, AWS Marketplace Operations <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: June payout withheld — invoice shows VAT hold and entity mismatch

Folks — forwarding a customer report (Acme) that their June GCP Marketplace payout is on hold because the invoice tags lines to Acme EMEA LLC instead of Acme US Inc. They attached the June invoice.

Quick summary of asks: 
- Can Marketplace operations confirm whether the listing mapping or SKUs were routed to the wrong seller-entity for June 1–30?
- If so, what evidence will GCP need from us to trigger a seller-side credit or reroute?
- We should prepare a merchant ledger snapshot showing per-line entity attribution to share with the customer.

I'm attaching my working entity mapping (entity-mapping-lookup-202706.csv) — Jonas/Marcus, can you validate whether we've got a fallback mapping that would have applied during the June cutover to new SKU namespace? Naomi, can you pull the ledger snapshot for June 30 so I can share with Acme?

Timetable: Customer is asking for a resolution before their bank run on Friday (2027-07-02). If we need a credit memo, let's aim for approval by 2027-07-01 EOD.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Marketplace Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
(evelyn_hart@redwood.com)

— Attachment: entity-mapping-lookup-202706.csv (lookup table)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, GCP Billing Support <gcp-billing-support@google.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: June payout withheld — invoice shows VAT hold and entity mismatch

Evelyn — I pulled the June ingest and ran a quick compare against our seller-entity mapping. Preliminary findings: there was a fallback rule that applied to a subset of SKU prefixes between 2027-06-12 and 2027-06-18 during a metadata cutover. Those prefixes were routed to the legacy seller-entity (Acme EMEA LLC) when the primary mapping table returned a 404 for new SKUs; the fallback defaulted to the EMEA entity for several metered lines.

Actionable next steps I recommend: 
1) Create a retrospective credit memo for the affected invoice lines. We should mark the credit reason as "entity attribution error — SKU fallback".
2) Coordinate with GCP Billing to reassign the lines for payout rerouting (they usually accept a merchant-side ledger snapshot + our mapping proof).
3) Provide Acme a signed statement and the CSV ledger snapshot showing corrected per-line attribution.

I've attached the merchant ledger snapshot (merchant-ledger-snapshot-20270630.csv) with line_ids and tentative corrected entity_id. Marcus/Naomi — please sanity-check the corrected attribution and confirm amounts eligible for credit.

If GCP needs an expedited ticket, I'll open one today and loop AWS Marketplace ops just to cover cross-marketplace artifacts.

— Jonas
Senior Marketplace Ops Engineer
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Acme Analytics <billing@acme.com>, Acme Finance <finance@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, GCP Billing Support <gcp-billing-support@google.com>
Date: 2027-07-02T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps to clear payout hold — Acme Analytics (June 2027)

Hi Lara / Acme team —

Thanks for the quick flag. Internal update and next steps: 

1) Root cause: We confirmed a SKU mapping fallback during a metadata cutover (2027-06-12 to 2027-06-18) that caused several metered lines to be attributed to Acme EMEA LLC. 
2) What Redwood will deliver by 2027-07-02 EOD: a signed merchant ledger snapshot showing corrected per-line attribution and a draft credit memo for the affected lines. Jonas attached the ledger CSV for your review. 
3) What we need from Acme to expedite GCP reassign: a signed statement on company letterhead confirming the preferred payout entity (Acme US Inc.) and any tax documents the marketplace requires (you mentioned W-9). Once we have that, Redwood will submit the evidence bundle to GCP Billing and request reroute + payout release.

Proposed customer timeline:
- Today (2027-07-02): you confirm the preferred entity and share signed W-9 (if not already provided).
- 2027-07-03: Redwood submits ticket + evidence to GCP.
- 2027-07-05 to 2027-07-07: GCP processes reassignment and issues credit/adjustment (target window; external).

If anything on your side is time-sensitive for the bank run, please flag the specific amount and we can prioritize the lines for an interim credit.

Thanks again — apologies for the disruption. We'll follow up in-thread when the GCP ticket is opened and we have the ticket number.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Marketplace Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
(evelyn_hart@redwood.com)

— Attachments: merchant-ledger-snapshot-20270630.csv; entity-mapping-lookup-202706.csv
